gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net release of GBP 1.3 million in prior year reserves in 2014, described as a "surplus run-off deviation". This was driven by a GBP 2.0 million surplus on direct business, primarily from the fire and other damage to property books, offset by a GBP 0.7 million deficit on reinsurance accepted business, mainly from the casualty book. The 2012 year of account showed favourable development due to better than expected claims experience in engineering and power, while the 2013 year of account experienced adverse development from a large number of small claims and a significant Canadian construction loss.
